evidence: frontend/apps/mobile/src/onboarding/FeedbackManager.ts:139 getDrafts() does `return stored ? JSON.parse(stored) : [];` with NO try/catch. A corrupt or truncated FEEDBACK_DRAFTS_KEY value in AsyncStorage (e.g. an interrupted write, storage corruption, or a stale value from an older schema) makes JSON.parse throw synchronously, so the whole getDrafts() promise rejects and the feedback-draft UI that awaits it crashes instead of degrading to an empty list.

frontend/apps/mobile/src/onboarding/FeedbackManager.ts:229 getPendingFeedback() has the identical unguarded pattern `return stored ? JSON.parse(stored) : [];` against PENDING_FEEDBACK_KEY. getPendingFeedback feeds the pending-feedback sync/flush path, so a single corrupt entry throws and blocks ALL queued feedback from ever syncing (no isolation, no self-heal).

This is the SAME class of bug the team already fixed elsewhere in this segment: the prior open finding code-review-mobile-rn-widget-provider-json-parse flagged WidgetDataProvider.getAllWidgetConfigs() for the exact `return stored ? JSON.parse(stored)...` anti-pattern, and the hardened modules in this app (layoutCache.readCachedLayout L22-27, TourManager.loadState L277, HelpCenter.loadUserVotes L191) all wrap the parse in try/catch and drop/ignore the bad value. FeedbackManager was missed.

Fix vector: wrap each JSON.parse in try/catch returning [] on failure (and ideally AsyncStorage.removeItem the corrupt key, matching layoutCache). Beyond the throw, the parsed value is also returned untyped (no cast, no shape guard) so a wrong-shape-but-valid-JSON blob would propagate malformed drafts/submissions downstream. Confidence medium: the missing guard and the throwing path are certain by static read; not upgraded to high because triggering it requires already-corrupt local storage, not normal input.

frontend/apps/mobile/src/qrcode/QRCodeScanner.ts:368 getScanHistory() does `return stored ? JSON.parse(stored) : [];` against SCAN_HISTORY_KEY with NO try/catch — the same unguarded-persisted-parse anti-pattern as FeedbackManager above.

Blast radius is wider than a read-only getter because getScanHistory() is also on the WRITE path: saveScanToHistory() (frontend/apps/mobile/src/qrcode/QRCodeScanner.ts:345 `const history = await getScanHistory();`) calls it before appending a new entry. So if SCAN_HISTORY_KEY is corrupt, scanning a fresh QR code throws inside saveScanToHistory and the post-scan success handler crashes — not just the history-list screen. (This is distinct from parsePPTPayload at L138, which IS correctly try-caught.)

Note the asymmetry: the parse of UNTRUSTED scanned QR payload (parsePPTPayload, L136-142) is defensively wrapped, but the parse of the app's OWN persisted history — which can still be corrupted by a partial write or OS-level storage issue — is not. Both should be guarded.

Fix vector: wrap JSON.parse in try/catch returning [] (and remove the corrupt key), so a bad history blob self-heals on the next scan instead of blocking all future scans. Confidence medium: throwing path certain by static read; requires already-corrupt storage to trigger.

frontend/apps/mobile/src/onboarding/FeedbackManager.ts is a public manager class (saveDraft/getDrafts/getPendingFeedback/submit flow + draft serialization) with ZERO test coverage: a repo-wide search `find frontend/apps/mobile -iname '*feedback*test*'` returns nothing, and no FeedbackManager.test.* exists anywhere in the tree.

By contrast the neighbouring onboarding/qrcode modules that were recently hardened DO have tests (qrcode/universalLinks.test.ts, qrcode/DeepLinkHandler.test.ts; services/ has backgroundNotifications.test.ts, deepLinkRouting.test.ts, resetLocalData.test.ts), so the gap is specific to FeedbackManager, not a segment-wide norm.

This mirrors the prior accepted Tester finding code-review-mobile-rn-widgets-no-tests (public classes driving a feature with no tests), applied to a different untested public manager. The missing coverage is also what let the unguarded-JSON.parse defects above (sibling finding code-review-mobile-rn-feedbackmgr-json-parse) ship unnoticed — a corrupt-storage unit test would have caught them.

Fix vector: add a FeedbackManager.test.ts covering (a) getDrafts/getPendingFeedback with corrupt stored JSON (should not throw), (b) draft round-trip save/get, (c) pending-feedback flush. Low severity / test-coverage gap. Confidence medium.
